summary: The patched head passes the UI check on both targets. The wasm accessibility failure in r2 was caused by the wasm test bundle not packaging Compose string resources, so the localized assertion could never resolve there. The assertion now runs in the JVM test source set, where resources load, and still checks the exact expand/collapse content descriptions, state descriptions and button role; the common FileTree tests are unchanged otherwise. JVM 56 run / 2 skipped / 0 failed including FileTreeAccessibilityTest 1/1; wasm 59 run / 3 skipped / 0 failed; spotless passes; the three preview composables are present in the compiled class.
